<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'expanded_value'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment exercising parser comment handler -->
  <sub:child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like text: <child>&ent;</child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "RecordEntity">
  <!ENTITY combined "&base; Extended">
  <!ENTITY % ext_macro "<!ENTITY nested 'ParamEntityContent'>">
  %ext_macro;
]>
<?target-pi data="processing-instruction-content"?>
<database xmlns="http://xml.org/db" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:type="extended">
  <!-- Comment inside database element -->
  <record xlink:type="locator" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with entity reference representation: &combined; &nested;
    ]]>
  </record>
</database>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "FirstEntity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; SecondEntity">
  <!ENTITY % dtd_par "<!ENTITY deep 'DeepEntity'>">
  %dtd_par;
]>
<?xml-meta version="1.0"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment preceding item element -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA content with &ent2; and &deep; embedded.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&ent2;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock*)>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY itemA "Widget A">
  <!ENTITY itemB "Widget B: &itemA;">
  <!ENTITY % macro_ent "<!ENTITY meta_ent 'MetaValue'>">
  %macro_ent;
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.com/inventory" xmlns:store="http://example.com/store">
  <!-- Inventory tracking comment -->
  <store:stock store:code="A1">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw inventory notes: <stock>&itemB;</stock> &meta_ent;
    ]]>
  </store:stock>
  <stock>&itemB;</stock>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY secEnt "SectionEntity">
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ENTITY pVal 'ParamVal'>">
  %pEnt;
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY extDoc SYSTEM "doc.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css"?>
<document xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns">
  <!-- Comment detailing the multi-namespace document -->
  <ns:section ns:attr="test">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with &secEnt; and &pVal; and special chars <>&"'.
    ]]>
  </ns:section>
  <section>&secEnt;</section>
</document>
